The computer program analyzed the noise exposure for five sections adjacent to I-94 and the Airport Spur as shown in Figure 19. The results shown in Figure 23 indicate sections A,B,C, and D will be exposed to 
L_{10}
 noise levels ranging from 66-70dDA, the higher readings being at the right of way line. Section E will be exposed to 
L_{10}
 noise levels ranging from 60-64dBA. Areas more than 400 feet from both I-94 and the Airport Spur will be exposed to lower noise levels.
The predicted exterior 1990 L<sub>10</sub> noise level at Hamlin Sarland School during the peak traffic hours will be 68dBA; inside the classroom the noise level will be 54dBA with the windows open and 45dBA with the windows closed. Hoise levels during normal school hours will be 1dBA less than those above. These noise levels are based on the measured attenuation characteristics of the school and result in inside and outside noise levels below the standards.
